August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 137)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American network, Bela Lugosi and John Carradine in Charles Michelson's syndicated thriller Mystery House, Evelyn MacGregor singing Irving Berlin hits on The American Melody Hour for Bayer Aspirin, Bruce Foote starring as François Villon in The Vagabond King on WGN's Chicago Theater of the Air, two classic Bob and Ray satires (the Boston flea circus in 1948 and Mary Backstayge on a coal barge in 1952), and Elliott Lewis in Speed Gibson of the International Secret Police (1939–1955):
